```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r Import libraries, echo = FALSE}
library(plyr) # round by 0.5
library(lubridate) # dates 
library(ggplot2)# graphs 
library (DHARMa)# test autocorrelation
library (FSA)# Dunn's test
```

```{r setup the data}

# charging dataset 
data_monitor_rain <- read.csv("DATA/pro/fid_monitor_rainyss_process.csv", header= T, sep = ";")
#View(data_monitor_rain)

# Exclude obs other than V salvator
data_monitor_rain = data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$sp=="V_salva" ) ,]
#View(data_monitor_rain)

# Exclude obs without FID
data_monitor_rain = data_monitor_rain[!is.na(data_monitor_rain$FIDi),]
#View(data_monitor_rain)

# Exclude obs without size
data_monitor_rain = data_monitor_rain[!is.na(data_monitor_rain$size),]
#View(data_monitor_rain)

# Exclude obs without distance from closest shelter 
data_monitor_rain = data_monitor_rain[!is.na(data_monitor_rain$d_fr_refug),]
#View(data_monitor_rain)


# Standardize the dates  
dates = data_monitor_rain$date

# lubridate automatically detects format
standardized_dates = parse_date_time(dates, orders = "dmy")

# Convert to date class 
standardized_dates = as.Date(standardized_dates)

#standardized_dates

data_monitor_rain$date = standardized_dates #replace in the dataset with the "new" dates

# Create datasets for each sites separately 
data_rain_salaya =  data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site=="salaya" ) ,]
data_rain_phuttha =  data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site=="phutthamonthon" ) ,]

```

```{r FID vs SITE: mean and standard deviation}

summary(data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site== "salaya" ) ,]$FIDi) # mean  
sd(data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site== "salaya" ) ,]$FIDi) # standard deviation

summary(data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site== "phutthamonthon" ) ,]$FIDi) # mean 
sd(data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site== "phutthamonthon" ) ,]$FIDi) # standard deviation

```

```{r  FID vs SITE: number of obs per site}

table(data_monitor_rain$site) # table

ggplot(data_monitor_rain, aes(x=site)) + # graph
  geom_bar()

```

```{r FID vs SITE: Kruskal-Wallis}

kruskal.test(data_monitor_rain$FIDi~as.factor(data_monitor_rain$site), data=data_monitor_rain)

```
```{r FID vs SITE: Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon}

wilcox.test(data_rain_salaya$FIDi, data_rain_phuttha$FIDi)

```

```{r FID vs SITE: Plot}

p = ggplot(data = data_monitor_rain)+ #dataset
    geom_boxplot(mapping = aes(x = site, y = FIDi, color = site))+ #variables and color by site
    scale_color_brewer(palette="Dark2")+ #colorblind friendly palette 
    theme(legend.position="none", axis.text=element_text(size=16), axis.title=element_text(size=18)) #remove the legend 
p = p + labs(x = "Site", # x axis name 
    y = "FID (m)", #y axis name
    title ="Rainy season")+ #graph title
    scale_x_discrete(labels=c("phutthamonthon" = "Phutthamonthon", 
                              "salaya" = "Mahidol"))
p

```

```{r FID vs SIZE: SALAYA: mean and standard deviation for each size class}

# Small individuals
summary(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "S" ) ,]$FIDi) #mean FID 3.533
sd(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "S" ) ,]$FIDi) # sd = 1.9

# Medium individuals
summary(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "M" ) ,]$FIDi) #mean FID 2.478
sd(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "M" ) ,]$FIDi) # sd = 2.2

# Large individuals
summary(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "L" ) ,]$FIDi) #mean FID 1.60
sd(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "L" ) ,]$FIDi) # sd = 1.2

```

```{r FID vs SIZE: SALAYA: number of obs per size class}

table(data_rain_salaya$size) # table

ggplot(data_rain_salaya, aes(x=size)) + #graph
  geom_bar()

```

```{r FID vs SIZE: SALAYA: Kruskal-Wallis}

kruskal.test(data_rain_salaya$FIDi~as.factor(data_rain_salaya$size), data=data_rain_salaya) # yup


# post hoc test with bonferroni correction
dunnTest(FIDi ~ size,
         data=data_rain_salaya,
         method="bonferroni")
```


```{r FID vs SIZE: SALAYA: Plot}

p = ggplot(data = data_rain_salaya)+
    geom_boxplot(mapping = aes(x = size, y = FIDi), color = "#d95f02")
p = p + labs(x = "Size (L = Large, M = Medium, S = Small)", 
    y = "FID (m)",
    title ="Rainy season: Mahidol")+ #graph title
    theme(axis.text=element_text(size = 16), axis.title=element_text(size = 18))
    
p 
```

```{r FID vs SIZE: PHUTTHAMONTHON: number of obs per size class}
table(data_rain_phuttha$size) # table

```


```{r FID vs SIZE: PHUTTHAMONTHON: Plot }
    geom_boxplot(mapping = aes(x = size, y = FIDi), color = "#1b9e77")# variables and site color
p = p + labs(x = "Size (L = Large, M = Medium, S = Small)",  # x axis name 
    y = "FID (m)", #y axis name
```

```{r CLOSEST vs CHOSEN SHELTER}

# remove observations without closest or chosen shelter
data_shelter_rain = data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$closest_ref_type!="" ) ,]
#View(data_shelter_dry)
data_shelter_rain = data_shelter_rain[(data_shelter_rain$gone_ref_type!="" ) ,]
#View(data_shelter_dry)

# contingency table with chosen in columns and closest in rows
table = table(data_shelter_rain$closest_ref_type, data_shelter_rain$gone_ref_type)
addmargins(table)

```

```{r ln() transformation}

# we ln() transform to account for skewed data
ln_monitor_rain = data_monitor_rain
ln_monitor_rain$FIDi =  log1p(ln_monitor_rain$FIDi) # transforms with natural logarithm after adding 1 to every measure to keep absence as 0. 
ln_monitor_rain$d_fr_refug =  log1p(ln_monitor_rain$d_fr_refug)
#View(ln_monitor_rain)

# we recreate de salaya and phutthamonthon datasets
ln_rain_salaya =  ln_monitor_rain[(ln_monitor_rain$site=="salaya" ) ,]
ln_rain_phuttha =  ln_monitor_rain[(ln_monitor_rain$site=="phutthamonthon" ) ,]

```

```{r FID vs DISTANCE FROM SHELTER: SALAYA: model initiation}

# model 
model_dfs_ln_s <- lm(FIDi ~ d_fr_refug , data=ln_rain_salaya)

# diagnostic plots 
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
plot(model_dfs_ln_s) 

```

```{r FID vs DISTANCE FROM SHELTER: SALAYA: residuals normality}

# residuals 
model_dfs_ln_s.res <- residuals(model_dfs_ln_s)

# plot 
p = ggplot()
p = p+ylab ("Frequency")
p = p + xlab ("Pearson residuals")
p = p + theme (panel.background = element_blank())
p = p + theme (panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1))
p = p + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill="white", color ="white", linewidth = 1))
p = p + theme(text = element_text(size = 15))
p = p+ geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "white", data = ln_rain_salaya, aes(model_dfs_ln_s.res), bins = 12)
p 

# test
shapiro.test(model_dfs_ln_s.res) # OK 

```

```{r FID vs DISTANCE FROM SHELTER: SALAYA: homoskedasticity}

bptest(model_dfs_ln_s) 

```

```{r FID vs DISTANCE FROM SHELTER: SALAYA: spatial autocorrelation}

# residuals
res_dharmareg_inter = simulateResiduals(model_dfs_ln_s)

#test 
testSpatialAutocorrelation(res_dharmareg_inter, x =  ln_rain_salaya$long, y = ln_rain_salaya$lat) 

```

```{r FID vs DISTANCE FROM SHELTER: SALAYA: temporal autocorrelation}

### on the scale of field days ###

# recalculate residuals to account for repetitive dates (aggregate by time)
res_grouped_reg_day <- recalculateResiduals(res_dharmareg_inter, group = ln_rain_salaya$date)

# Test temporal autocorrelation 
testTemporalAutocorrelation(res_grouped_reg_day, time = unique(ln_rain_salaya$date)) # okay

### on an hour scale ###

# extract the hour 
ln_rain_salaya$hour <- as.POSIXct(paste(ln_rain_salaya$date, ln_rain_salaya$time), format="%Y-%m-%d %H")

# recalculate residuals to account for repetitive dates (aggregate by time)
res_grouped_reg_hour <- recalculateResiduals(res_dharmareg_inter, group = ln_rain_salaya$hour)

# Test temporal autocorrelation 
testTemporalAutocorrelation(res_grouped_reg_hour, time = unique(ln_rain_salaya$hour)) # okay 

```


```{r FID vs DISTANCE FROM SHELTER: SALAYA: results and plot}

# Results
summary(model_dfs_ln_s)  

#Plot the data
p = ggplot(data = ln_rain_salaya)+ # dataset 
    geom_point(mapping = aes(x = d_fr_refug, y = FIDi), color = "#d95f02" ) # variables and site color 
p = p + 
        xlab("ln(Distance from closest shelter) (m)") + #x axis name
        ylab("ln(FID) (m)") + #y axis name
        ggtitle("Rainy season: Mahidol") + #graph title
        theme(axis.text=element_text(size = 16), axis.title=element_text(size = 18))
p
```
